answer: By the grove of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the voyage until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pulse of the next round.
